subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
english: I understand the general idea, but I missed a few important details.
portuguese: Percebo a ideia geral, mas perdi alguns detalhes importantes.
pronunciationNote: pair-SEH-boo ah ee-DAY-ah zheh-RAL mash pair-DEE al-GOONSH duh-TAL-yush eem-por-TAN-tush
notes: B1 should let the learner explain exactly what part of the conversation failed.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Pode repetir só essa parte?
exampleSentences.english: Can you repeat just that part?

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
english: Could you explain that part again, but using simpler words?
portuguese: Podia explicar essa parte outra vez, mas com palavras mais simples?
pronunciationNote: poo-DEE-ah esh-plee-KAR EH-sah PAR-tuh OH-trah vaysh mash kohng pah-LAH-vrash mysh SEEM-plush
notes: A natural next step after a simple repeat request is not enough.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Acho que percebi o assunto, mas não a explicação toda.
exampleSentences.english: I think I understood the subject, but not the whole explanation.

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
english: Could you speak a little more slowly so I can follow the conversation?
portuguese: Podia falar um pouco mais devagar para eu conseguir acompanhar a conversa?
pronunciationNote: poo-DEE-ah fah-LAR oong POH-koo mysh deh-vah-GAR PAH-rah ew kohn-seh-GEER ah-kohn-pah-NYAR ah kohn-VER-sah
notes: A fuller B1 version of asking someone to slow down.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Ainda estou a habituar-me ao ritmo.
exampleSentences.english: I am still getting used to the pace.

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
english: I am not sure I understood correctly; are you saying that it has changed?
portuguese: Não tenho a certeza se percebi bem; está a dizer que isso mudou?
pronunciationNote: nawng TEN-yoo ah sir-TEH-zah suh pair-seh-BEE beng shTAH ah dee-ZER kuh EE-soo moo-DOH
notes: Combines uncertainty with a concrete check.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Antes de responder, queria confirmar isso.
exampleSentences.english: Before answering, I wanted to confirm that.

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
english: Do you mean that we need to decide before the end of the day?
portuguese: Quer dizer que temos de decidir antes do fim do dia?
pronunciationNote: ker dee-ZER kuh TEH-moosh duh deh-see-DEER AN-tush doo feeng doo DEE-ah
notes: A complete interpretation check, not just a phrase fragment.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se for isso, tenho de falar com outra pessoa primeiro.
exampleSentences.english: If that is the case, I need to speak to someone else first.

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
english: If I understood correctly, the problem is not the price but the timing.
portuguese: Se percebi bem, o problema não é o preço, mas sim o prazo.
pronunciationNote: suh pair-seh-BEE beng oo proo-BLEH-mah nawng eh oo PREH-soo mash seeng oo PRAH-zoo
notes: B1 learners should start summarising the point of a discussion.

exampleSentences.portuguese: É isso que queria dizer?
exampleSentences.english: Is that what you meant?

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
english: Let me see if I understood: first we confirm the details, and then we pay.
portuguese: Deixe-me ver se percebi: primeiro confirmamos os detalhes e depois pagamos.
pronunciationNote: DAYSH-muh ver suh pair-seh-BEE pree-MAY-roo kohn-feer-MAH-moosh oosh duh-TAL-yush ee duh-POYSH pah-GAH-moosh
notes: A fuller conversational management card with sequence markers.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Quero evitar confusões.
exampleSentences.english: I want to avoid confusion.

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
english: Can I check one thing before we continue with the rest?
portuguese: Posso confirmar uma coisa antes de continuarmos com o resto?
pronunciationNote: POS-soo kohn-feer-MAR OO-mah KOY-zah AN-tush duh kohn-tee-noo-AR-moosh kohng oo HESH-too
notes: A practical way to pause a conversation politely.

exampleSentences.portuguese: É só para ter a certeza.
exampleSentences.english: It is just to be sure.

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
english: Can I interrupt for a second? I think I missed something important.
portuguese: Posso interromper por um segundo? Acho que perdi uma coisa importante.
pronunciationNote: POS-soo een-tuh-rom-PER poor oong suh-GOON-doo AH-shoo kuh pair-DEE OO-mah KOY-zah eem-por-TAN-tuh
notes: More natural than interrupting without explaining why.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Depois pode continuar.
exampleSentences.english: Then you can continue.

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
english: Before you continue, can I ask a quick question about what you just said?
portuguese: Antes de continuar, posso fazer uma pergunta rápida sobre o que acabou de dizer?
pronunciationNote: AN-tush duh kohn-tee-NOO-ar POS-soo fah-ZER OO-mah pair-GOON-tah HAH-pee-dah SOH-br oo keh ah-kah-BOH duh dee-ZER
notes: A practical phrase for real conversation timing.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Não quero perder o fio à conversa.
exampleSentences.english: I do not want to lose the thread of the conversation.

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
english: Sorry, I interrupted you; please go on with what you were saying.
portuguese: Desculpe, interrompi-o; continue com o que estava a dizer, por favor.
pronunciationNote: desh-KOOL-p een-tuh-rom-PEE-oo kohn-tee-NOO kohng oo k esh-TAH-vah ah dee-ZER poor fah-VOR
notes: Use interrompi-a for a female person in formal address.

exampleSentences.portuguese: A minha pergunta pode esperar.
exampleSentences.english: My question can wait.

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
english: What I wanted to say was that I need a little more time to think about it.
portuguese: O que eu queria dizer era que preciso de mais um pouco de tempo para pensar nisso.
pronunciationNote: oo keh ew kuh-REE-ah dee-ZER EH-rah kuh pruh-SEE-zoo duh mysh oong POH-koo duh TEM-poo PAH-rah pen-SAR NEE-soo
notes: A full reformulation with a clear message.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Não quero responder sem pensar bem.
exampleSentences.english: I do not want to answer without thinking properly.

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
english: I do not think I explained myself clearly, so let me try again.
portuguese: Acho que não me expliquei claramente, por isso deixe-me tentar outra vez.
pronunciationNote: AH-shoo kuh nawng muh esh-plee-KAY klah-rah-MEN-tuh poor EE-soo DAYSH-muh ten-TAR OH-trah vaysh
notes: A natural B1 way to recover after unclear speech.

exampleSentences.portuguese: É mais simples do que parece.
exampleSentences.english: It is simpler than it seems.

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
english: What I mean is that it is possible, but it may take longer than expected.
portuguese: Quero dizer que é possível, mas pode demorar mais do que o esperado.
pronunciationNote: KEH-roo dee-ZER kuh eh poo-SEE-vel mash POD duh-moh-RAR mysh doo kuh oo esh-puh-RAH-doo
notes: A full clarification with contrast and qualification.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Não é uma resposta definitiva.
exampleSentences.english: It is not a final answer.

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
english: That is not exactly what I meant; I was talking about the situation in general.
portuguese: Não era exatamente isso que eu queria dizer; estava a falar da situação em geral.
pronunciationNote: nawng EH-rah egz-ah-tah-MEN-tuh EE-soo kuh ew kuh-REE-ah dee-ZER esh-TAH-vah ah fah-LAR dah see-too-ah-SAWNG eng zheh-RAL
notes: A stronger, complete version of correcting a misunderstanding.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Não estava a falar de uma pessoa específica.
exampleSentences.english: I was not talking about a specific person.

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
english: I see your point, but I think there is another way to look at it.
portuguese: Percebo o seu ponto de vista, mas acho que há outra forma de ver a questão.
pronunciationNote: pair-SEH-boo oo sew PON-too duh VEESH-tah mash AH-shoo kuh ah OH-trah FOR-mah duh ver ah kesh-TAWNG
notes: A useful independent-speaker disagreement frame.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Não estou a dizer que esteja errado.
exampleSentences.english: I am not saying that you are wrong.

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
english: I agree with part of that, but I am not sure I agree with the conclusion.
portuguese: Concordo com uma parte disso, mas não tenho a certeza se concordo com a conclusão.
pronunciationNote: kohn-KOR-doo kohng OO-mah PAR-tuh DEE-soo mash nawng TEN-yoo ah sir-TEH-zah suh kohn-KOR-doo kohng ah kohn-kloo-ZAWNG
notes: B1 nuance without becoming too abstract.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Talvez falte alguma informação.
exampleSentences.english: Maybe some information is missing.

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
english: I am not completely sure, but I think the second option makes more sense.
portuguese: Não tenho a certeza absoluta, mas acho que a segunda opção faz mais sentido.
pronunciationNote: nawng TEN-yoo ah sir-TEH-zah ab-soh-LOO-tah mash AH-shoo kuh ah suh-GOON-dah op-SAWNG fash mysh sen-TEE-doo
notes: A complete opinion with hedging.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Pelo menos parece mais simples.
exampleSentences.english: At least it seems simpler.

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
english: From what I understood, we have two options, but neither is perfect.
portuguese: Pelo que percebi, temos duas opções, mas nenhuma é perfeita.
pronunciationNote: PEH-loo kuh pair-seh-BEE TEH-moosh DOO-ash op-SOYNGSH mash nuh-NOO-mah eh pair-FAY-tah
notes: A natural phrase for summarising a discussion.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Temos de escolher a menos complicada.
exampleSentences.english: We have to choose the less complicated one.

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
english: That depends on the situation, especially if we are talking about work.
portuguese: Isso depende da situação, sobretudo se estivermos a falar de trabalho.
pronunciationNote: EE-soo duh-PEN-duh dah see-too-ah-SAWNG soh-bruh-TOO-doo suh esh-tee-VER-moosh ah fah-LAR duh trah-BAH-lyoo
notes: Shows conditional thinking in a practical way.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Num contexto informal, talvez seja diferente.
exampleSentences.english: In an informal context, maybe it is different.

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
english: It is hard to explain, but I will try to give you a simple example.
portuguese: É difícil de explicar, mas vou tentar dar-lhe um exemplo simples.
pronunciationNote: eh dee-FEE-seel duh esh-plee-KAR mash voh ten-TAR DAR-lyuh oong ehk-ZEM-ploo SEEM-plush
notes: A useful phrase for buying time and continuing.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Talvez assim seja mais claro.
exampleSentences.english: Maybe that way it will be clearer.

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
english: I need a moment to think about how to say this in Portuguese.
portuguese: Preciso de um momento para pensar em como dizer isto em português.
pronunciationNote: pruh-SEE-zoo duh oong moo-MEN-too PAH-rah pen-SAR eng KOH-moo dee-ZER EESH-too eng poor-too-GAYSH
notes: Keeps the conversation in Portuguese while buying time.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Não quero mudar logo para inglês.
exampleSentences.english: I do not want to switch straight to English.

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
english: How can I explain this without making it sound too complicated?
portuguese: Como é que posso explicar isto sem fazer parecer demasiado complicado?
pronunciationNote: KOH-moo eh kuh POS-soo esh-plee-KAR EESH-too seng fah-ZER pah-reh-SER duh-mah-ZYAH-doo kohm-plee-KAH-doo
notes: A good B1 conversation filler for learners.

exampleSentences.portuguese: A ideia é simples, mas a explicação não é.
exampleSentences.english: The idea is simple, but the explanation is not.

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
english: Can you tell me if this sentence sounds natural in European Portuguese?
portuguese: Pode dizer-me se esta frase soa natural em português europeu?
pronunciationNote: POD dee-ZER-muh suh ESH-tah FRAH-zuh SOH-ah nah-too-RAL eng poor-too-GAYSH eh-oo-roo-PAY-oo
notes: Useful because correctness and naturalness are different things.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Não quero usar uma frase que soe traduzida.
exampleSentences.english: I do not want to use a phrase that sounds translated.

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
english: How would you normally say that in a casual conversation?
portuguese: Como diria isso normalmente numa conversa informal?
pronunciationNote: KOH-moo dee-REE-ah EE-soo nor-mal-MEN-tuh NOO-mah kohn-VER-sah een-foor-MAL
notes: Asks for natural everyday phrasing rather than a dictionary answer.

exampleSentences.portuguese: A tradução literal parece-me estranha.
exampleSentences.english: The literal translation seems strange to me.

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
english: Can you give me a more common expression for this situation?
portuguese: Pode dar-me uma expressão mais comum para esta situação?
pronunciationNote: POD dar-m OO-mah esh-pruh-SAWNG mysh koo-MOONG PAH-rah ESH-tah see-too-ah-SAWNG
notes: A useful phrase for improving spoken Portuguese.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Quero evitar uma expressão demasiado formal.
exampleSentences.english: I want to avoid an expression that is too formal.

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
english: I do not want to take too much of your time, but I have one last question.
portuguese: Não quero ocupar muito do seu tempo, mas tenho uma última pergunta.
pronunciationNote: nawng KEH-roo oh-koo-PAR MOOY-too doo sew TEM-poo mash TEN-yoo OO-mah OOL-tee-mah pair-GOON-tah
notes: A useful closing frame for help-seeking conversations.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Depois deixo-o continuar.
exampleSentences.english: Then I will let you continue.

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
english: Thanks, that helped a lot; I think I understand the difference now.
portuguese: Obrigado, isso ajudou muito; acho que agora percebo a diferença.
pronunciationNote: oh-bree-GAH-doo EE-soo ah-zhoo-DOH MOOY-too AH-shoo kuh ah-GOH-rah pair-SEH-boo ah dee-fuh-REN-sah
notes: Use obrigada if the speaker is female.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Antes estava a confundir as duas coisas.
exampleSentences.english: Before, I was confusing the two things.

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
english: We can come back to this later if it is easier to explain with more time.
portuguese: Podemos voltar a isto mais tarde se for mais fácil explicar com mais tempo.
pronunciationNote: poo-DEH-moosh vol-TAR ah EESH-too mysh TAR-duh suh for mysh FAH-seel esh-plee-KAR kohng mysh TEM-poo
notes: A polite way to pause a difficult conversation.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Agora não quero atrasar ninguém.
exampleSentences.english: Right now I do not want to delay anyone.

subject: Everyday Conversation Tools
english: I can explain it better in writing if that would be clearer.
portuguese: Posso explicar melhor por escrito, se isso for mais claro.
pronunciationNote: POS-soo esh-plee-KAR meh-LYOR poor esh-KREE-too suh EE-soo for mysh KLAH-roo
notes: Useful when spoken explanation is difficult.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Às vezes escrevo melhor do que falo.
exampleSentences.english: Sometimes I write better than I speak.
